items.title: 'Law & Order's E.J. Carroll Dies Suddenly at 66 While Traveling to New Job
items.summary:
Law & Order and Boardwalk Empire actor E.J. Carroll died unexpectedly while en route to a voiceover job. He was 66.

Carroll’s manager, Jon Mason , confirmed on Saturday, November 21, that the veteran character actor collapsed on the street in New York City on Thursday, November 19, while on his way to record lines for an upcoming commercial, per Entertainment Weekly .

A cause of death has not been determined. Mason noted that Mason had recently undergone a medical procedure to correct a hernia.

A memorial service will be held in New York City at a later date.

The Most Shocking Celebrity Deaths of All Time: Hayden Panettiere and More 

“When E.J. Carroll performed, it was impossible to take your eyes off him,” Mason said on Saturday. “But his lasting legacy will be the kindness and generosity he showed his friends, fellow performers and even strangers.”

Mason added that Carroll was “as good a human being as it gets.”

Us has reached out to Carroll’s representative for further information but did not hear back at the time of publication.

Carroll made his TV acting debut in 1998 via a guest spot in the original Law & Order . This brief appearance began a longstanding relationship that saw Carroll play at least seven characters across Law & Order and its spinoffs, Criminal Intent and Special Victims Unit .

He appeared in two episodes of acclaimed HBO crime drama Boardwalk Empire as the crooked Sheriff Victor Sickles, in addition to starring in six episodes of porn industry drama The Deuce as shop owner Fat Mooney.

Throughout his career, Carroll made guest appearances…

items.title: Jenny McCarthy Recalls Getting 'Cheap' Breast Augmentation at 19
items.summary:
Jenny McCarthy is getting candid about her previously botched breast augmentation procedure .

“This was back when I was living on the south side of Chicago and all of my girlfriends were going to Arizona to get this boob job that was on sale for $1,500,” McCarthy, 54, recalled on the Thursday, November 19, episode of her eponymous podcast . “They would come back with the most gorgeous freaking cleavage you’d ever seen. Growing up as an athlete and not having a lot of meat on my bones, I craved boobs.”

Following in her friends’ footsteps, a then-19-year-old McCarthy “saved up” her money to get her own procedure. 

“I go to Arizona, I do the appointment. He’s like, ‘OK.’ I tell him, ‘I just want small C’s just so they’re not that noticeable.’ I go in for the surgery. I’m very, very nervous,” she said of the plastic surgeon. “Halfway through the surgery, I wake up on the table and I literally say to the doctor, ‘Um, I’m awake.’ And he goes, ‘Oh, yeah. Well, we’ve got just one more boob to go.’”

Jenny McCarthy Defends Keeping Breast Implants Amid Mold Poisoning 

McCarthy was admittedly “freaking out” that the anesthesia allegedly wore off before the second implant was even surgically placed in her chest.

“He’s like, ‘Just hang out, just chill. You’ll be fine.’ I remember him saying, “You won’t remember a thing.’ I remember everything, buddy,” she quipped. “Now I know why it was so cheap ‘cause they didn’t put us to sleep!”

McCarthy continued, “During a boob job surgery, I had no idea they did this, but once they put the implants in, they press a button … and the table…
items.t: Jenny McCarthy Recalls Getting 'Cheap' Breast Augmentation at 19

items.title: Taylor Swift Gifts Megan Moroney Personalized Letter After 2026 CMAs Return
items.summary:
Megan Moroney made sure to give Taylor Swift her flowers — literally — after her highly anticipated 2026 CMAs comeback. And, no, the 14-time Grammy winner didn’t take it lightly.

“On cloud 9 at the CMA awards!” Moroney, 29, wrote via Instagram on Friday, November 20, alongside a carousel of images from the celebratory evening.

In one slide, Moroney revealed that Swift, 36, gifted her a personalized poster ahead of the big show.

“Megan! Thank you SO much for these beautiful flowers,” Swift wrote in her message. “That was incredibly thoughtful and I hope you have a fantastic night! I’d send you flowers back but also all I have in my dressing room is merch. Just pretend it’s a lovely bouquet?”

Breaking Down Taylor Swift's Stylish Easter Eggs in 2026 CMAs Performance 

She concluded, “Go get ‘em!! Love, Taylor.”

Moroney and Swift both attended the 60th annual CMAs on Wednesday, November 18, in honor of their respective nominations . Moroney was recognized in the Song of the Year and Female Artist of the Year categories, both of which she lost to Ella Langley . Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” also triumphed as Single of the Year over Swift’s “I Knew It, I Knew You.”

Amid their respective losses, Moroney and Swift each performed during the live broadcast. For Swift, her return marked the first time she sang on the CMAs stage in 13 years.

Courtesy of Megan Moroney/Instagram 
 Dressed in a bedazzled Erdem minidress and cowboy boots, Swift mashed up the Toy Story 5 track with “Our Song” from her debut album. The pop star further leaned into her country roots by enlisting her…

items.title: Donald Trump Reacts to Ex 'DOGE' Leader Elon Musk Claiming He's 'Not MAGA'
items.summary:
President Donald Trump is reacting to the former leader of the so-called Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) Elon Musk claiming he’s no longer “MAGA” in the wake of the Republican party’s historic midterm election losses .

“He’s a friend of mine,” Trump, 80, said while speaking to NBC News on Thursday, November 19. “What can I tell you? I mean, you have to ask — there’s a lot of definitions out there. MAGA, to me, means something very specific, and when people veer from it, they don’t do very well.”

The president continued, “But Elon is — Elon’s got very good intentions. I mean, he was with me the whole — he traveled with me.”

After Musk, 55, spent nearly $500 million on the 2026 midterm elections in an attempt to prop up GOP candidates in various states — only to have the Democratic party turn a number of so-called “red” states blue, including Texas, Mississippi, Alaska and more – the once leader of the infamous DOGE initiative denounced the political movement he once shamelessly championed.

“I mean, I’m not MAGA,” the world’s first trillionaire — who earned more than a reported $200 billion in Trump’s first year of his second term and over $913 billion during year two of the former reality TV star’s second stint in the Oval Office — told The New York Times on Wednesday, November 18, during the outlet’s DealBook Summit .

items.title: David Beckham's perfume, Poundland – and a mighty, mighty stink | Arwa Mahdawi
items.summary:
The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
